# CheckBox and Radio have no component coverage, and radio exclusivity is engine-enforced

## Context

`test/playwright/component/form/field/` holds arms for Text, TextArea, Number, ComboBox and Chip. It holds none for CheckBox or Radio. Across the whole suite, the only thing that touches either is `unit/form/field/IdSync.spec.mjs`, which asserts internal id syncing — **Radio has no coverage at all.**

That gap has already cost something. #18817 was filed (by me) claiming a landing render writes back over a user's click on a checkbox, on the strength of a unit fixture that held a flight open. It closed `not_planned` after a real-browser measurement showed no revert and zero engine `checked` writes. With an arm pinning the real contract, the claim would have been settled in a minute instead of a ticket.

**Measured in a real browser** (`examples/form/field/checkbox`, engine at `aadafbad1b`), by redefining `checked` on the live `<input>` so every write is recorded with its previous value:

| Probe | Result |
|---|---|
| CheckBox, 1 / 2 / 3 / 5 / 8 rapid clicks | DOM always ends on the user's state; **0** engine `checked` writes |
| Radio, native click on a sibling | engine writes `{was: false, wrote: false}` — redundant, the browser already grouped |
| Radio, `setConfigs({checked: true})` with **no** native click | engine writes `{was: true, wrote: false}` to the sibling's DOM |
| Radio, same probe with `uncheckGroupItems()` **disabled** | sibling DOM `false`, sibling **config `true`** — the divergence only the engine closes |

The **last** row is the load-bearing one, and it corrects my first reading of the third: native grouping does reach the config path, so the DOM is not the discriminator. The config is. Nothing guards it.

Live latest-open sweep: latest 20 open issues read at 2026-09-17T11:05Z, plus a targeted search on radio / checkbox / component coverage — only #18817, closed. `grep` over `resources/content/issues` and `resources/content/discussions` for `radiofield` / `field/Radio`: no artifact. A2A: no claim on form-field coverage. Own-assignment sweep: no overlap.

## The Problem

Three contracts are live, consumer-visible, and unguarded:

1. **Radio exclusivity is enforced by the engine on the CONFIG surface; the browser owns the DOM.** `Radio#afterSetChecked` calls `uncheckGroupItems()`, which resolves siblings via `ComponentManager.find({ntype: 'radiofield', name})` and assigns `item.checked = false`. Native grouping covers same-name radios in one document on a click **and** on a `checked` property assignment, so the DOM half survives without the engine. What does not survive is the losing radio's config: measured with the method disabled, the sibling reads DOM `false` / config `true`. A regression here is invisible to any DOM-only test and leaves a form holding two selected values.
2. **A `checked` delta is applied as a property, not an attribute.** `checked` is in `voidAttributes`, so `DeltaUpdates.mjs:886` runs `node[key] = val === 'true'`. That is what lets the engine override a user's interaction at all — the reason it is safe today is contract 3, not luck.
3. **A user click emits no `checked` delta.** `CheckBox#onInputValueChange` syncs the vnode and then sets `me.checked`, so the vdom already agrees with the DOM and the next render diffs a value against itself. Break the ordering and the property write from contract 2 lands on top of a real click. This is exactly the failure #18817 imagined; nothing currently stops it becoming true.

## The Architectural Reality

- `src/form/field/Radio.mjs:41-45` — `afterSetChecked` → `value && this.uncheckGroupItems()`.
- `src/form/field/Radio.mjs:68-84` — `uncheckGroupItems()` finds by `ntype` + `name` and writes `item.checked = false`, skipping itself and anything already false.
- `src/form/field/CheckBox.mjs:610-620` — `onInputValueChange()` writes `me.vnode.childNodes[0].childNodes[me.hideLabel ? 0 : 1].attributes.checked`, then assigns `me.checked`.
- `src/vdom/domConstants.mjs:28` — `voidAttributes` includes `checked`.
- `src/main/DeltaUpdates.mjs:886` — `node[key] = val === 'true'` for every void attribute.
- `test/playwright/component/form/field/Text.spec.mjs` — the arm idiom: `createNeoInstance` into `component-test-viewport`, real Playwright clicks, DOM assertions.

## The Fix

Two spec files under `test/playwright/component/form/field/`, following the sibling idiom exactly — real browser, real clicks, no vdom-internal fixtures:

- `Radio.spec.mjs` — exclusivity by click and by config, the group scoped by `name`, and the DOM property as the assertion surface rather than the config.
- `CheckBox.spec.mjs` — the click-to-DOM round trip, the programmatic round trip, and the no-redundant-delta property.

No source changes. If an arm reds, that is a defect report, not a fixture to adjust.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] **AC-1** — Radio: clicking one radio unchecks its same-name sibling, asserted on the DOM `checked` **property** of both inputs.
- [ ] **AC-2** — Radio: `setConfigs({checked: true})` on one radio, with **no** click anywhere, leaves the sibling's **`checked` config** false, not merely its DOM. Mutation-measured discriminator with `uncheckGroupItems()` disabled: sibling DOM `false`, sibling config **`true`** — a silent divergence nothing else repairs. *(Corrected: I first wrote that native grouping cannot reach the config path. It can — the browser unsets same-name siblings on a `checked` property assignment too, so a DOM-only arm passes with the method deleted. The config is the half the engine owns.)*
- [ ] **AC-3** — Radio: a radio carrying a **different** `name` is untouched by both of the above, so the arm pins the group scope rather than "some radio somewhere changed".
- [ ] **AC-4** — CheckBox: a real click reaches the component config, and a `setConfigs({checked})` change reaches the DOM property — both directions, in one arm each.
- [ ] **AC-5** — CheckBox: after a burst of rapid clicks, the DOM property matches the parity of the click count and the config agrees. *(Scope correction: this does NOT pin the `onInputValueChange` vnode-sync ordering. Measured — deleting that line leaves both CheckBox arms green, because the `me.checked` assignment on the next line is what suppresses the delta. The arms guard the round trip, which had no coverage; they do not guard the sync, and the spec says so.)*
- [ ] **AC-6** — both files run in the existing `components` CI job with no config change, and the full `component` suite stays green.

## Out of Scope

- **Re-parenting**, within one window or across two. @tobiu's call: that belongs in e2e, not here, and it is the one scenario the #18817 measurement did not rule out. It rides #18802's premise question rather than this ticket.
- Any `src/` change. If an arm goes red, it gets its own ticket.
- `labelPosition` / `hideLabel` / `valueLabel` styling arms — Text already establishes that idiom and copying it here adds rows without adding evidence.
- `form.field.Radio`'s `getGroupValue()` submit-shape and form integration.

## Avoided Traps

- ⛔ **Do not assert on the component config.** `checked` reaching `me.checked` proves nothing about the DOM — the whole #18817 confusion lived in that gap. Assert the DOM property, which is what `DeltaUpdates` writes and what a user sees.
- ⛔ **Do not let native browser grouping stand in for the engine's.** A click-only radio arm passes with `uncheckGroupItems()` deleted. AC-2 exists precisely because it is the arm that cannot.
- ⛔ **Do not hold a vdom flight open to manufacture a race.** That is the fixture shape that produced a ticket for a defect that does not exist. If a race needs proving, prove it on a real surface.

## Related

- #18792 / PR #18798 — the `form.field.Text` sibling, which had a real e2e receipt
- #18802 — the re-parenting scenario is parked behind its premise question
